name: codex-tools-bridge
description: Set up and diagnose an experimental macOS-first MCP bridge from ChatGPT Web to native local Codex tools.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and diagnose the ChatGPT-to-Codex MCP bridge.
interface.longDescription: An installation and diagnostic skill for Codex Tools Bridge. ChatGPT Web owns reasoning and conversation context; the separately configured local host executes native tools with configured permissions by default. Installing this skill does not start a tunnel or grant tool access. Experimental and macOS-first; an independent project, not an official OpenAI product.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Codex Tools Bridge in a fresh dedicated workspace.
